questions.question: What did the Teacher, who wrote about life under the sun, say about the fate of the righteous and the wicked?

answers.text: They all answer to the king

questions.question: The Teacher who wrote about life under the sun said people know what lies ahead, whether love or hate. True or false?
The Teacher who wrote about life under the sun said a live dog is better than a dead lion. True or false?
The Teacher said the race is not always to the swift or the battle to the strong. Why?

answers.text: Time and chance happen to all
